title: Cobblemon The Fakes
description: This modpack aims in making a great experience for fakemon in cobblemon.
body:
# 🌿 Welcome to the Official **Cobblemon The Fakes** Modpack Page on Modrinth!

Are you a Minecraft fan who's always dreamed of a world where Cobblemon feels truly complete and full of surprises you've never seen before? Then you've found your new home.

**Cobblemon The Fakes** brings together the beloved Cobblemon experience and the incredible **Alatia's Fakemon Pack** to create something that feels less like a modpack and more like an entirely new game. Every biome, every cave, every mountain hides something waiting to be discovered, and not all of it is what you'd expect.

---

## 🌍 A World Built for Exploration

From the moment you spawn in, the world around you is alive. Familiar Cobblemon roam the landscapes you know and love, but venture far enough and you'll start encountering something different. Creatures born from imagination, carefully designed Fakemon that blend into the Minecraft world so naturally you'd swear they were always meant to be there.

Whether you're trekking through dense forests, diving into ocean depths, or scaling towering peaks, there's always a new face waiting to be found. Every environment tells a story, and every Fakemon you encounter is a chapter in it.

---

## ✨ The Fakemon Experience, Done Right

Alatia's Fakemon Pack doesn't just add new creatures. It expands the soul of what Cobblemon is. These Fakemon are designed with the same care and intention as the originals, fitting seamlessly alongside the full Cobblemon roster without ever feeling out of place.

This isn't a pack that just throws content at you. Every Fakemon has a place in the world. Every encounter feels intentional. The goal was simple: make Minecraft, Cobblemon, and Fakemon feel like they were always one game, and that's exactly what **Cobblemon The Fakes** delivers. 

To see the mons added go [HERE](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1llvUEyGHt168Yxad7I3MOiAbNV0Lntlvm1cYhjKlfmM/edit?usp=sharing)

---

## 🎮 What Makes Cobblemon The Fakes Different?

🐾 **Full Cobblemon Experience** catch, train, and battle with the complete Cobblemon roster

🌟 **Alatia's Fakemon Pack** a handcrafted collection of original Fakemon woven into the world

🌿 **Immersive Integration** Fakemon spawn naturally across biomes, making exploration endlessly rewarding

⚔️ **Battle Your Way** take on wild Pokémon and Fakemon in fluid, satisfying combat

🏡 **Build and Explore** Minecraft's core survival and creativity loop intact and enhanced

🤝 **Multiplayer Ready** adventure solo or bring your friends along for the ride

---

## 🧭 Made for Trainers Who Want More

If you've played Cobblemon before and felt like something was missing, a sense of mystery, of discovery, of genuinely not knowing what you might find next, **Cobblemon The Fakes** is the answer. The Fakemon keep even veteran players on their toes, and the seamless world integration means there's no jarring separation between the Cobblemon part and the Minecraft part.

This is the whole package. One world. One adventure. Endless possibilities.

---

## 🔧 Performance & Compatibility

⚙️ Optimized for smooth performance

🧠 Designed for Minecraft Java Edition

💾 Minimum **4GB RAM** recommended, 6GB or more for the best experience

🌐 Multiplayer compatible, play with friends easily

---

## 🌟 Your Adventure Starts Here

Choose your partner, step into the world, and find out what's waiting for you out there. It might be something you recognize. It might be something nobody has ever seen before.

Either way, **Cobblemon The Fakes** is ready when you are.

**Catch the unexpected. That's what we're here for.**

---
